note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: What are the names of conductors, ordered by age?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Age ASC

questions.question: What are the names of conductors whose nationalities are not "USA"?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM conductor WHERE Nationality != 'USA'

questions.question: How many different nationalities do conductors have?
List the name of the conductor with the most years of work.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Year_of_Work DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show the names of conductors and the orchestras they have conducted.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  T2.Orchestra FROM conductor AS T1 JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID

questions.question: Show the names of conductors that have conducted more than one orchestras.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM conductor AS T1 JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID GROUP BY T2.Conductor_ID HAVING COUNT(*)  >  1

questions.question: What are the names of conductors who have conducted at more than one orchestra?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM conductor AS T1 JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID GROUP BY T2.Conductor_ID HAVING COUNT(*)  >  1

questions.question: Show the name of the conductor that has conducted the most number of orchestras.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM conductor AS T1 JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID GROUP BY T2.Conductor_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Please show the name of the conductor that has conducted orchestras founded after 2008.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM conductor AS T1 JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID WHERE Year_of_Founded  >  2008

questions.question: Please show the different record companies and the corresponding number of orchestras.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Record_Company ,  COUNT(*) FROM orchestra GROUP BY Record_Company

questions.question: Count the number of orchestras that have CD or DVD as their record format.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orchestra WHERE Major_Record_Format  =  "CD" OR Major_Record_Format  =  "DVD"

questions.question: What are years of founding for orchestras that have had more than a single performance?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Year_of_Founded FROM orchestra AS T1 JOIN performance AS T2 ON T1.Orchestra_ID  =  T2.Orchestra_ID GROUP BY T2.Orchestra_ID HAVING COUNT(*)  >  1
